testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a hidden sketch panel after reopening the sketch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the full Sketch ribbon displays the Pattern panel ✔ When the user hides Pattern using Show Panels in the Sketch tab context menu ✔ And the user finishes the sketch without changing geometry ✔ And the user reopens the same sketch from the model browser ✔ Then the Sketch ribbon is visible without the Pattern panel ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Sketch tab context menu ✔ Then Pattern is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Pattern ✔ Then the Pattern panel returns to the Sketch ribbon
